provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Quacks of Quedlinburg rulebook (Schmidt Spiele, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Scoring Track in the middle; Flame on space 1 of the Turn Indicator; 4 seal tiles on the seal spaces, 0 up
Orange and black books out (black book on the page for your player count)
Green, blue and red books from one set, chips sorted beside them; yellow and purple books aside until turns 2 and 3
Each player: a pot (side without test tubes up), a bag, a scoring marker on their seal tile, droplet on 0
Flask full side up on the large trivet; rat stone on the small trivet
Into your bag: 4 white 1-chips, 2 white 2-chips, 1 white 3-chip, 1 orange 1-chip, 1 green 1-chip
The last person to cook goes first; they shuffle the Fortune Teller cards into a facedown pile
